# Security policy

## Report a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/koimari/scryglass/security/advisories/new). Include the affected route or component, reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested fix.

Please keep the report private until a fix is available. Scryglass will acknowledge a report within five business days and will provide status updates during investigation.

## Supported version

The production version at [scryglass.xyz](https://scryglass.xyz) and the current `main` branch receive security fixes.

## Scope

The web application, public APIs, publication worker, Supabase policies, and release tooling are in scope. Social engineering, denial of service against third-party data providers, and reports that require publishing private data are outside the testing scope.
